title: No Head Break
description: Mob heads no longer break when touched by water — and they can even be waterlogged, just like slabs or fences!
body:
### No Head Break — Waterlogged Mob Heads
### Mob heads no longer break when touched by water — and they can be fully waterlogged.

![Vanilla Heads](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5a51f3946e453438db2aacd63784dbde1760a68.png)

By default, Minecraft destroys any mob head that comes into contact with water. With this mod installed, heads resist water completely — flowing or source water will never pop them off.

![full waterlogging](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/308a470a16d62e62f95fe256250408456095c5a6.jpeg)

Heads also support full waterlogging. Place a head underwater and it fills with water automatically. You can also right-click any head with a water bucket to waterlog it manually, and use an empty bucket to remove the water — exactly like stairs or slabs.

![All Heads](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b8537d8e7a4b49193a81e47bbaa0fcc949c3cb1.png)

This works with every type of head — vanilla skulls, player heads, and heads added by mods like Just Mob Heads or Just Player Heads. If a mod adds heads, this mod covers them.

Fabric API required
This mod requires Fabric API. It must be installed on both client and server.
